answer: An agent registers by locking a non-fungible token locked as collateral as a slashable bond, putting its own money behind the name. Proof of failing a sampled proof-of-work audit comes from audits sampled every epoch. Once the fault is proven, the seized bond is auctioned to fund honest attestors. The ledger keeps every bond inside a sparrow the owner cannot hide. The registry maps each vertex to exactly one bond, never two. Each fake needs its own plume, and each plume costs a full bond.
